messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"chapter":4,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"verse":31,"chapter":4,"text":"Ponder now by yourself, how much fruit of wickedness a grain of evil seed has produced."},{"verse":32,"chapter":4,"text":"When the grains which are without number are sown, how great a threshing floor they will fill!”"},{"verse":33,"chapter":4,"text":"Then I answered and said, “How long? When will these things come to pass? Why are our years few and evil?”"},{"verse":34,"chapter":4,"text":"He answered me, and said, “Don’t hurry faster than the Most High; for your haste is for your own self, but he who is above hurries on behalf of many."},{"verse":35,"chapter":4,"text":"Didn’t the souls of the righteous ask about these things in their chambers, saying, ‘How long will we be here? When does the fruit of the threshing floor come?’"},{"verse":36,"chapter":4,"text":"To them, Jeremiel the archangel answered, ‘When the number is fulfilled of those who are like you. For he has weighed the world in the balance."},{"verse":37,"chapter":4,"text":"By measure, he has measured the times. By number, he has counted the seasons. He won’t move or stir them until that measure is fulfilled.’”"},{"verse":38,"chapter":4,"text":"Then I answered, “O sovereign Lord, all of us are full of ungodliness."},{"verse":39,"chapter":4,"text":"Perhaps it is for our sakes that the threshing time of the righteous is kept back—because of the sins of those who dwell on the earth.”"},{"verse":40,"chapter":4,"text":"So he answered me, “Go your way to a woman with child, and ask of her when she has fulfilled her nine months, if her womb may keep the baby any longer within her.”"}]}
